text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PD-4789 fired for model-catalog-service - high error rate on model resolution. Auto-runbook started.

pagerduty: Alert triggered: catalog-resolve-503 x 120 in 5m. Escalation: eng-sre -> eng-runtime -> oncall.

Maria Chen: saw this in prod dashboards, errors started ~12:04 UTC, spike to 40% failed model loads. Customers hitting chat endpoints returned short/garbled outputs.

Jon Park: I think it's the catalog entry that references rev "r2026-03-badtok" — tokenizer mismatch message in the logs: "tokenizer: incompatible for model variant".

Priya Singh: Confirmed. Logs from catalog service: `model_id: gptx-3-open, revision: r2026-03-badtok, tokenizer: v2` but runtime expects `tokenizer: v1`. Rehydration failing at load time -> fallback route not triggering because variant tag mismatch.

Kevin O'Neill: @eng-runtime-oncall can you check routing policy? We need to immediate fallback traffic to gptx-3-open@stable while we fix catalog.

eng-runtime-oncall: On it. Creating emergency route to stable variant now, will flip traffic to stable for affected customers. Patching catalog locally then pushing.

sre_lead: Maria, please do quick blast to #support for any customer-facing tickets we should prioritize and get a list of active customer IDs affected. Also snapshot of 5xx targets.

Maria Chen: Yep, pinged support, they have three customers reporting garbled tokens and an enterprise partner with high error volume. Copying IDs in thread: cust-1128, cust-7733, cust-EE-09.

Jon Park: Applying rollback patch to catalog entry. Command I'm using:

```bash
# switch catalog revision back to stable for gptx-3-open
curl -X PATCH "https://catalog.internal.redwood/api/v1/models/gptx-3-open" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CATALOG_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"revision":"r2026-02-stable","tokenizer":"v1","force_reload":true}'

# verify
curl -s "https://catalog.internal.redwood/api/v1/models/gptx-3-open" | jq .revision
```

Priya Singh: Thanks. I see the rollback applied in the staging copy. Prod patch queued. Note: we need to also clear prefix/KV caches on runtime nodes so clients don't see mixed state.

eng-runtime-oncall: Rolling back prod catalog now. Will also trigger KV cache flush via the runtime admin endpoint.

Kevin O'Neill: Good. What's the expected customer impact window while we rotate?

eng-runtime-oncall: Estimated 90s for route flip + 2m for KV flush across region, total <5 minutes. We'll monitor.

incident-bot: Incident timeline note: PD-4789 acknowledged by Maria Chen at 12:07 UTC.

Maria Chen: Acknowledged. Updating support with mitigation and ETA.

Jon Park: After rollback, I see model loads succeed and tokenizer mismatch logs stop. Responses for test requests look normal.

Priya Singh: Still seeing some garbled outputs from cached sessions for a minute — flushing user session caches helps. Command: `POST /runtime/admin/flush_sessions?region=us-west`

eng-runtime-oncall: Done. Flushed sessions in us-west and eu-central.

Maria Chen: Support confirms improved responses for reported customers, cust-1128 and cust-7733 both show normal behavior now. cust-EE-09 still intermittent, investigating.

sre_lead: Good work. Let's mark the incident as mitigated once we confirm no new errors for 15 minutes. Also capture RCA notes: how did bad revision get promoted?

Jon Park: Preliminary: a promotion job used a tagging script that pulled the latest artifact by timestamp; an automated build pushed a candidate revision with tokenizer v2 but missing compatibility metadata. The promotion tool didn't validate tokenizer metadata.

Priya Singh: Action items: (1) add metadata validation to catalog promotion pipeline, reject if tokenizer mismatch with runtime supported list; (2) add automatic canary routing so new revisions get <=1% traffic first; (3) add alert for tokenizer-incompatibility on catalog apply.

Kevin O'Neill: I'm picking up the patch work for (1) and (3). Jon/ Priya can you add the canary routing change to rollout infra?

Jon Park: I'll open PR against rollout-service and add a test for tokenizer compatibility.

Maria Chen: I'll draft post-incident customer note and coordinate with CS for follow-ups.

incident-bot: PD-4789 resolved at 12:14 UTC (manual resolution by eng-runtime-oncall).

sre_lead: We'll keep thread open for a full RCA doc. If anyone needs a handoff, our on-call rotation for the evening is @sre-evening-oncall.

eng-runtime-oncall: Handoff to 'night' oncall at 12:30 UTC — leaving playback commands and logs pinned in S3: s3://redwood-incidents/PD-4789/playback.log

Maria Chen: Thanks all — closing mitigation loop now. Please add follow-up tasks to the incident board. :white_check_mark:

Priya Singh: Adding tasks: #inc-4789-validate, #inc-4789-canary, #inc-4789-alerts.

Kevin O'Neill: Retro scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

Jon Park: Will attach quick diff of the promotion script to the RCA.

sre_lead: Good job. Monitoring for 30m, then mark as postmortem-ready. :thumbsup:
